name: See What New AI
conditions: Free submit requires placing their backlink tag on your website ('Need to exchange backlink')
Free tier is reviewed in about 3 months; listing stays 'until removed'
Paid 'Basic' $10 one-time: no backlink needed, reviewed in ~1 week, consumes 1 credit
requirements: Sign-in required to access the submit form
AI tools only: 'AI must be a meaningful part of the product's user-facing functionality or core workflow'
Not accepted: NSFW, violent/gore, illegal, scams, phishing, or tools that misuse personal data
Site needs a proper favicon (they use automated capture) and should be publicly accessible - forced logins/aggressive bot detection slow review
preparation: Create an account (sign-in gates the form)
For free: place the SeeWhatNewAI anchor tag on your site and note where
Ensure a favicon exists and the homepage renders without login walls
workflow: Enter Website Name + Website URL and choose plan: Free (backlink, ~3 months) or Basic $10 (1 credit, ~1 week)
Free: paste the provided backlink tag on your site; Paid: pay and the credit is consumed per submission
Review queue applies; updates to a live listing go via email (support@seewhatnewai.com)
watchFor: Credit model: paid submissions consume 1 credit each; publication is 'not guaranteed' even when paid - refunds via email if rejected
Cross-promo banner inside the form pitches a different directory ('Pikkai') - ignore unless desired
The catalog's listed submissionUrl (/sign-up) is just the account page; the real form is /submit behind login
Free-tier listing persists 'until removed' - backlink removal likely invalidates it
They explicitly warn that dofollow link indexing/DR impact is not guaranteed
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the seewhatnewai.com directory/explore pages with a dofollow outbound link.
unknowns: Whether free submissions without a backlink are ever approved
Re-verification of the required backlink after approval
